headers.//: Broad rule first: HTML and anything unhashed must revalidate. The previous `**/*.@(html|xml|txt)` pattern never matched the root path `/`, so index.html was served with Firebase's default max-age=3600 — meaning a returning visitor could hold stale HTML pointing at hashed assets that no longer exist in the current release.
Content-hashed filenames change whenever the bytes change, so these are safe to cache forever. Declared after the broad rule so it wins.
